questions.stem: The relation \(R = \{(a, b) : b = a + 2\}\) defined in the set \(\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}\) is

options.label: A
options.text: not reflexive and symmetric, but transitive

options.label: B
options.text: not reflexive and transitive, but symmetric

options.label: C
options.text: not symmetric and transitive, but reflexive

options.label: D
options.text: not reflexive, not symmetric and not also transitive

options: स्वतुल्य और सममित नहीं, किन्तु संक्रामक
स्वतुल्य और संक्रामक नहीं, किन्तु सममित
सममित और संक्रामक नहीं, किन्तु स्वतुल्य

questions.stem: If the orders of the matrices \(A\) and \(B\) are \(m \times n\) and \(n \times p\) respectively, then the order of \(AB\) will be

hi.stem: यदि आव्यूहों \(A\) और \(B\) की कोटियाँ क्रमशः \(m \times n\) और \(n \times p\) हों, तो \(AB\) की कोटि होगी

questions._flag: A stamp covers the English 'A' and option (ii); the Hindi prints them clean.

questions.subtopic: Order and Degree of a Differential Equation
questions.stem:
The degree of the differential equation
\(7\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\right)^2 + 5\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 + x\frac{dy}{dx} + y = 0\) will be

hi.stem:
अवकल समीकरण
\(7\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\right)^2 + 5\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 + x\frac{dy}{dx} + y = 0\) की घात होगी

questions.stem: The direction cosines of the vector \(\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) are

hi.stem: सदिश \(\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) की दिक्-कोज्याएँ हैं

questions._flag: A stamp covers the end of the Hindi stem; completed as 'दिक्-कोज्याएँ हैं' from the visible letters and the English.

questions.stem: If \(R^{*}\) be the set of all non-zero real numbers, then the mapping \(f : R^{*} \rightarrow R^{*}\) defined by \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x}\) is

hi.stem: यदि \(R^{*}\) सभी शून्येतर वास्तविक संख्याओं का समुच्चय हो, तो \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x}\) द्वारा परिभाषित प्रतिचित्रण \(f : R^{*} \rightarrow R^{*}\) है
options: न तो एकैकी और न ही आच्छादक

questions._flag: The superscript on R is printed as a heavy dot in both languages; stored as R^{*}.

questions.subtopic: Domains, Ranges and Principal Value Branches
questions.stem: Find the principal value of \(\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\).

hi.stem: \(\cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\) का मुख्य मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: A stamp covers the English cos^{-1}; the Hindi prints it clean.

questions.stem:
Test whether the function \(f : R \rightarrow R\) defined by
\(f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5, & \text{if } x \le 1 \\ x - 5, & \text{if } x > 1 \end{cases}\)
is continuous at \(x = 1\).

hi.stem:
जाँच कीजिए कि क्या
\(f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5, & \text{यदि } x \le 1 \\ x - 5 & \text{यदि } x > 1 \end{cases}\) द्वारा
परिभाषित फलन \(f : R \rightarrow R\), \(x = 1\) पर संतत है या नहीं।

questions._flag: A stamp covers the English 'R →'; the Hindi prints f : R → R clean.

questions.stem: Find the value of \(\int x^3 e^{x^4}\, dx\).

hi.stem: \(\int x^3 e^{x^4}\, dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: If \(P(B) = \frac{9}{13}\) and \(P(A \cap B) = \frac{4}{13}\), find \(P(A | B)\).
questions._flag: A stamp covers 4/13 in the Hindi; the English prints it clean.

questions.stem: Let \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j}\) and \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j}\). Is \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}|\) ? Are the vectors \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) equal ?

hi.stem: मान लीजिए कि \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j}\) और \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j}\) है। क्या \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}|\) ? क्या सदिश \(\vec{a}\) और \(\vec{b}\) समान हैं ?

questions.subtopic: Derivatives of Implicit and Inverse Trigonometric Functions
questions.stem: Find the value of \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) if \(y = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x - x^3}{1 - 3x^2}\right)\), where \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} < x < \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).

hi.stem: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए यदि \(y = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x - x^3}{1 - 3x^2}\right)\), जहाँ \(-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} < x < \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).

questions._flag: A stamp covers tan^{-1} in the Hindi; the English prints it clean.

questions.stem: Find the value of \(\int \frac{1}{x^2 - a^2}\, dx\).

hi.stem: \(\int \frac{1}{x^2 - a^2}\, dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: If \(R_1\) and \(R_2\) are equivalence relations in the set \(A\), prove that \(R_1 \cap R_2\) is also an equivalence relation in \(A\).

hi.stem: यदि \(R_1\) और \(R_2\) समुच्चय \(A\) में तुल्यता सम्बन्ध हैं, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(R_1 \cap R_2\) भी समुच्चय \(A\) में एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है ।

questions.stem: If two vectors \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) are such that \(|\vec{a}| = 2\), \(|\vec{b}| = 3\) and \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 4\), find \(|\vec{a} - \vec{b}|\).

hi.stem: यदि दो सदिश \(\vec{a}\) और \(\vec{b}\) इस प्रकार हैं कि \(|\vec{a}| = 2\), \(|\vec{b}| = 3\) और \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 4\), तो \(|\vec{a} - \vec{b}|\) ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.subtopic: Equation of a Line in Space
questions.stem: The Cartesian equation of a line is \(\frac{x + 3}{2} = \frac{y - 5}{4} = \frac{z + 6}{2}\). Find its vector equation.

hi.stem: एक रेखा का कार्तीय समीकरण \(\frac{x + 3}{2} = \frac{y - 5}{4} = \frac{z + 6}{2}\) है । इसका सदिश समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: A stamp covers (y - 5)/4 in the Hindi; the English prints it clean.

questions.stem: A die is thrown once. If the event 'the number obtained on the die is a multiple of 3' is represented by \(E\) and 'the number obtained on the die is even' is represented by \(F\), tell whether the events \(E\) and \(F\) are independent.

hi.stem: एक पासे को एक बार उछाला जाता है । यदि घटना 'पासे पर प्राप्त संख्या 3 की अपवर्त्य है' को \(E\) से और 'पासे पर प्राप्त संख्या सम है' को \(F\) से निरूपित किया जाये, तो बताइए कि क्या घटनायें \(E\) और \(F\) स्वतन्त्र हैं ।

questions.stem: If \(A' = \begin{bmatrix} -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\) and \(B = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\), find \((A + 2B)'\).

hi.stem: यदि \(A' = \begin{bmatrix} -2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\) तथा \(B = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\), तो \((A + 2B)'\) ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Show that the function \(f(x) = \log \sin x\) is increasing in the interval \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) and decreasing in \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)\).

hi.stem: दिखाइए कि फलन \(f(x) = \log \sin x\) अन्तराल \(\left(0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) में वर्धमान और \(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)\) में ह्रासमान है ।

questions.stem: Find the value of the determinant \(\begin{vmatrix} x + y + 2z & x & y \\ z & y + z + 2x & y \\ z & x & z + x + 2y \end{vmatrix}\).

hi.stem: सारणिक \(\begin{vmatrix} x + y + 2z & x & y \\ z & y + z + 2x & y \\ z & x & z + x + 2y \end{vmatrix}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: A stamp covers the third column in the Hindi; the English prints it clean.

questions.stem: If \(y = x^{x^{x^{\cdots}}}\) to infinity, prove that \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^2}{1 - y \log x}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(y = x^{x^{x^{\cdots}}}\) अनन्त तक, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y^2}{1 - y \log x}\).

questions.stem: Evaluate : \(\int \sqrt{3 - 2x - x^2}\, dx\)

hi.stem: \(\int \sqrt{3 - 2x - x^2}\, dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: Prove that \(\cot^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{1 + \sin x} + \sqrt{1 - \sin x}}{\sqrt{1 + \sin x} - \sqrt{1 - \sin x}}\right) = \frac{x}{2}\), \(x \in (0, \pi/4)\)

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(\cot^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{1 + \sin x} + \sqrt{1 - \sin x}}{\sqrt{1 + \sin x} - \sqrt{1 - \sin x}}\right) = \frac{x}{2}\), \(x \in (0, \pi/4)\).

questions._flag: A stamp covers the middle signs of the fraction in the Hindi and partly in the English numerator; read together they give + above and - below.

questions.stem: For the differential equation \(xy\frac{dy}{dx} = (x + 2)(y + 2)\), find the curve passing through the point \((1, -1)\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(xy\frac{dy}{dx} = (x + 2)(y + 2)\) के लिए बिन्दु \((1, -1)\) से गुजरने वाला वक्र ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.stem: A person has taken the contract of a construction work. The probability of strike is 0.65. The probabilities of the construction work being completed on time in the circumstances of no strike and strike are respectively 0.80 and 0.32. Find the probability of the construction work being completed on time.

hi.stem: किसी व्यक्ति ने एक निर्माण कार्य का ठेका लिया है । हड़ताल होने की प्रायिकता 0.65 है । हड़ताल न होने की तथा हड़ताल होने की स्थितियों में निर्माण कार्य के समयानुसार पूर्ण होने की प्रायिकतायें क्रमशः 0.80 तथा 0.32 हैं । निर्माण कार्य के समयानुसार पूर्ण होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
questions.stem:
Minimize \(Z = 200x + 500y\) by graphical method subject to the following constraints :
\(x + 2y \ge 0\), \(3x + 4y \le 24\), \(x \ge 0\), \(y \ge 0\).

hi.stem:
निम्नलिखित व्यवरोधों के अन्तर्गत \(Z = 200x + 500y\) का न्यूनतमीकरण आलेखीय विधि से कीजिए :
\(x + 2y \ge 0\), \(3x + 4y \le 24\), \(x \ge 0\), \(y \ge 0\).

questions._flag: Both languages print the first constraint as x + 2y ≥ 0 (checked zoomed), kept as printed though the familiar version of this problem has x + 2y ≥ 10; a stamp covers the Hindi Z, taken from the English.

questions.stem:
Find the shortest distance between the lines whose vector equations are the following :
\(\vec{r} = (1 - t)\hat{i} + (t - 2)\hat{j} + (3 - 2t)\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{r} = (s + 1)\hat{i} + (2s - 1)\hat{j} - (2s + 1)\hat{k}\).

hi.stem:
रेखायें, जिनके सदिश समीकरण निम्नलिखित हैं, के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए :
\(\vec{r} = (1 - t)\hat{i} + (t - 2)\hat{j} + (3 - 2t)\hat{k}\) और \(\vec{r} = (s + 1)\hat{i} + (2s - 1)\hat{j} - (2s + 1)\hat{k}\).

questions._flag: A stamp covers 'निम्नलिखित' and (3 - 2t)k̂ in the Hindi; both read clean in the English.

questions.stem: For two vectors \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) prove that \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|\).

hi.stem: दो सदिशों \(\vec{a}\) तथा \(\vec{b}\) के लिए सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}| + |\vec{b}|\).

questions.stem:
If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -3 & 5 \\ 3 & 2 & -4 \\ 1 & 1 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\), find \(A^{-1}\).
Using \(A^{-1}\) solve the following system of equations :
\(2x - 3y + 5z = 11\)
\(3x + 2y - 4z = -5\)
\(x + y - 2z = -3\).

If \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -\tan\frac{\alpha}{2} \\ \tan\frac{\alpha}{2} & 0 \end{bmatrix}\) and \(I\) is the identity matrix of order 2, prove that
\(I + A = (I - A)\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\).

hi.stem:
यदि \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -\tan\frac{\alpha}{2} \\ \tan\frac{\alpha}{2} & 0 \end{bmatrix}\) तथा \(I\) कोटि 2 का तत्समक आव्यूह है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि
\(I + A = (I - A)\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\)

questions.stem: Prove that the semi-vertical angle of a right circular cone of given surface and maximum volume is \(\sin^{-1}(1/3)\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि दिये हुए पृष्ठ और महत्तम आयतन वाले लम्ब वृत्तीय शंकु का अर्धशीर्ष कोण \(\sin^{-1}(1/3)\) होता है ।

questions.stem: Prove that \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x\, dx = -\frac{\pi}{2} \log 2\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x\, dx = -\frac{\pi}{2} \log 2\).

questions._flag: A stamp covers -π/2 in the Hindi; the English prints it clean.

questions.stem: Find the area of the region bounded by the ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{9^2} + \frac{y^2}{4^2} = 1\).

hi.stem: दीर्घवृत्त \(\frac{x^2}{9^2} + \frac{y^2}{4^2} = 1\) से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।

questions._flag: A stamp covers (1 + y^2) in the English; the Hindi prints it clean.
